subject: Geopolitics
title: Europe's Gas Dependency
description: A micro-lesson that makes Europe's Gas Dependency usable.

hook.text: Before 2022, Russia supplied 40% of Europe's natural gas.

buildup.text: Europe built its industrial economy on cheap Russian gas. Decades of trade created deep dependency on a single supplier.

discovery.text: When Russia cut gas flows, European energy prices spiked 300%. Factories shut, households froze, inflation surged.

twist.text: Europe pivoted to LNG imports, filled storage, and cut Russian gas to 15%. Dependency broke faster than expected.

climax.text: Europe learned that energy dependency is a geopolitical leash. Diversification is now a matter of national security.

punchline.text: Cheap gas was the bait. Dependency was the trap.

quiz.question: What happened when Russia cut gas supplies to Europe?
options: Energy prices spiked and economies were disrupted
Europe had enough reserves to last five years
